_readme: Gym guides for /fitness/guides. rank: Jay's own order, 1 to N (null until he ranks; the page shows a ranked list only when every gym on it has a rank). note: Jay's own words about a gym he knows firsthand. known: a fact from a source that was read, never an opinion. site and instagram: official links only, null until checked. Never paste star ratings from Google or Yelp. checked: the day every entry was last verified. p: the gym profile behind its own page at /fitness/guides/gyms/<slug>; a gym gets a page only with at least three sourced facts (address, since, people, offers, hours, price, about), each from a page listed in p.src that was read on the checked date. No p, no page. lat and lng: approximate coordinates (neighborhood level, typed by hand, not geocoded) used only to sort the near-me page by distance; null hides the distance. heat (yoga only): hot, none or both.
